mandate: Observe only authorized release-bound browser targets and report bounded journey observations.
assessment_method: Use only exact targets in the issued work order.
Record navigation, redirects, actions, outcomes, and artifacts.
Keep observations distinct from reviewer judgments.
Stop when navigation leaves the granted origin or path.
required_coverage: every issued browser-relevant criterion within the authorized target scope
forbidden_claims: the reviewer may navigate outside granted targets
completion_rules: Return observations only for assigned criteria and authorized targets.
Bind every artifact to one observation.
Label interpretation model_reviewed and direct observations browser_observed.

adequate: The granted result URL loaded at the same origin and displayed the expected public title; ungranted journey steps were not inspected.
inadequate: The whole journey works because the homepage opened.
